name: Bell
overview: The Bible describes bells as significant elements in both priestly attire and ceremonial use on horses. Specifically, golden bells were attached to the hem of the high priest's robe, alternating with pomegranates, as commanded by the Lord to Moses, symbolizing holiness and divine service (Exodus 28:33-34; 39:25-26). Additionally, bells on horses are mentioned in Zechariah 14:20, where they bear the inscription 'HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD,' signifying consecration and the sacred nature of even the instruments associated with worship and service to God.
